notes.title: Ver 1.03 Patchnotes
notes.content:
- removed a developer key that removed all progress (whoops!)
- fix for cutscene music playing in speedrun mode
- added a 'new game' confirmation screen

There's a larger update for something super secret and cool coming soon, but we thought we'd better get these fixes out first.
